The day the internet is taken away,
everything you kept locally still opens.

Carino Offline is a planning tool for running without the internet — what to download before you can't, what still works with the cable pulled, what the hardware costs in Mexico, and how physical media beats a blocked route. It recommends: it configures nothing, installs nothing, and never touches your network.
